text: "You see, fellow soldiers, that perseverance is more prevailing than violence, and that many things which cannot be overcome when they are together, yield themselves up when taken little by little. Assiduity and persistence are irresistible, and in time overthrow and destroy the greatest powers whatever."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Sertorius
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
